recentItems.title: Happy Anniversary Now United!
recentItems.description:
What an incredible 9 years it has been! ✨
On August 31, 2017 the first 14 members of Now United were selected, paving the way for every new member who joined us throughout the years. Now United has changed so many lives, not only those of our 23 amazing members, but also the lives of our passionate fans, you Uniters.
Today we celebrate all the love, support, and joy you have shared with us over the past 9 years. Thank you for standing by our side, celebrating every moment, and helping us spread our message across the globe. Let's continue to spread the Now United message around the world! 🌏

Now & Forever,
Now United 💜
